entities.name: Kamigawa
entities.description: A plane strongly based on Japanese culture, governed by the interplay of mortals and kami, setting of the Champions, Betrayers, Saviors and Neon Dynasty sets.

entities.name: Kami
entities.description: Minor gods or spirits of Kamigawa that grow more powerful with the number of mortals who worship them.

entities.name: Kakuriyo
entities.description: The spirit world where the kami dwell.

entities.name: Utsushiyo
entities.description: The mortal half of Kamigawa's two realms.

entities.name: O-Kagachi
entities.description: The supreme kami and the kami of the veil, whose aspect was pulled through the veil by Konda.

entities.name: Nicol Bolas
entities.description: The Elder Dragon who described Kamigawa as a place where matter and spirit existed in perfect balance.

entities.name: Konda
entities.description: The daimyo who, with moonfolk accomplices, pulled an aspect of O-Kagachi through the veil, beginning the Kami War; defeated by Michiko.

entities.name: Kami War
entities.description: A twenty-year war in which enraged kami attacked the physical world after Konda's crime.

entities.name: Michiko Konda
entities.description: The princess who ended the Kami War, freeing the kidnapped scion and defeating O-Kagachi and Lord Konda.

entities.name: Toshiro Umezawa
entities.description: A black magician who aided Michiko in ending the Kami War.

entities.name: Kyodai
entities.description: The great kami, the freed scion, who guards the barrier between realms and guides the Imperials.

entities.name: Apocalypse Chime
entities.description: An artifact on Ulgrotha whose ringing weakened the veil around 3200 AR.

entities.name: Imperials
entities.description: The governing power of Kamigawa under the favor of Kyodai.

entities.name: Order of Jukai
entities.description: Monks who serve the kami and greet them as they merge into the mortal realm.

entities.name: Minamo Academy
entities.description: A scholarly academy whose scholars invented the merge gate mechanisms.

entities.name: Saiba Futurists
entities.description: Experimenters who found a way to draw on magic directly without bonding with a kami.

entities.name: Akki artisans of Sokenzanshi
entities.description: Artisans who crafted enhancers that let people use kami-granted powers efficiently.

entities.name: Jugan
entities.description: The orochi's original protector, resurrected by a ritual.

entities.name: Ryusei
entities.description: A dragon-kami who fought alongside Jugan to defeat the oni incursion.

entities.name: Night of Withering
entities.description: A devastating oni event that threatened the entire plane.

entities.name: Eiganjo
entities.description: A seat of Kamigawan power that descended into war over succession and later trained kami diplomats.

entities.name: Otawara
entities.description: A city that collaborated on merge gates and survived the invasion's devastation.

entities.name: Towashi
entities.description: The modern city whose growth threatens the kami.

entities.name: Boseiju
entities.description: The oldest and tallest tree in the Jukai, corrupted by Tamiyo during the invasion.

entities.name: Jukai
entities.description: A vast ancient forest of cedars home to many kami.

entities.name: Merge gates
entities.description: Gates built around rifts to let kami safely join a unified Kamigawa.

entities.name: Emperor
entities.description: The planeswalking ruler of Kamigawa whose spark Tezzeret destabilized and who later lost her spark in the Desparkening.

entities.name: Tezzeret
entities.description: A planeswalker sent by the New Phyrexian praetors to investigate the spirit realm and the spark.

entities.name: Jin-Gitaxias
entities.description: A Phyrexian praetor who traveled to Kamigawa and discovered how to compleat planeswalkers, first using it on Tamiyo.

entities.name: Tamiyo
entities.description: A planeswalker, Nashi's adoptive mother, compleated by Jin-Gitaxias and killed by the Wanderer.

entities.name: Kaito Shizuki
entities.description: A planeswalker who confronts Tamiyo at Boseiju.

entities.name: Nashi
entities.description: Tamiyo's adoptive son.

entities.name: Wanderer
entities.description: A figure who kills Tamiyo and promises to look after Nashi.

entities.name: Light-Paws
entities.description: The regent named by the Emperor to rule in her absence.

entities.name: Asari Uprisers
entities.description: Rebels whose rebellion ended when the Emperor stabilized her spark.

entities.name: New Phyrexian Invasion
entities.description: The invasion that targeted Kamigawa and slaughtered many kami.

entities.name: Snapdax
entities.description: One of Ikoria's behemoths that invaded Kamigawa through an Omenpath.

events.summary: Damage from the Apocalypse Chime weakens the veil, letting Konda pull an aspect of O-Kagachi through it and begin the Kami War.
The enraged kami attack the physical world to reclaim That Which Was Taken, and mortals lose a losing battle.
events.quote: Lord Konda's act greatly enraged the spirits, who turned against the physical world with a vengeance.

events.summary: In the war's twentieth year Michiko Konda frees the scion Kyodai and defeats O-Kagachi and Konda; O-Kagachi's death merges the two realms.
events.quote: The death of O-Kagachi caused the barrier between the two realms to break down

events.summary: An emperor dies without an heir and Eiganjo falls into war over succession.
events.quote: With no guidance, Eiganjo descended into all-out war

events.summary: A young Yamazaki soldier assassinates the late emperor's husband but is confronted by the brother.
events.quote: He successfully assassinated the late emperor's husband

events.summary: Kyodai strips the Konda family of their hereditary rule; future rulers will be elected by the kami.
events.quote: She stripped the Konda family of their hereditary duty as rulers.

events.summary: The orochi resurrect Jugan, who with Ryusei defeats the oni incursion after the Night of Withering.
events.quote: together, Jugan and Ryusei defeated the oni incursion.

events.summary: The Jukai discover overlapping realms and, with the Imperials and Minamo, build merge gates around the rifts.
events.quote: Through their combined effort, the mortals built gates around every new rift

events.summary: Akki enhancers and the Saiba Futurists' direct magic technique spark a technology boom.
events.quote: these two technologies soon combined to form the basis of the boom in new technology that exploded across the Plane.

events.summary: Tezzeret is sent to Kamigawa, clashes with the Emperor and destabilizes her spark with the Reality Chip.
events.quote: he destabilized her spark with the prototype Reality Chip before escaping.

events.summary: Jin-Gitaxias unlocks the secret of compleating planeswalkers and uses it on Tamiyo; the Emperor stabilizes her spark and names Light-Paws regent.
events.quote: eventually unlocking the secret to compleating planeswalkers before implementing it on his first subject, Tamiyo .

events.summary: The Phyrexians invade Kamigawa; samurai are quickly compleated and the incompleatable kami are slaughtered.
events.quote: The Kami, incompleatable, were simply slaughtered

events.summary: Compleated Tamiyo corrupts Boseiju and faces Kaito and Nashi; the Wanderer kills her at the last moment.
events.quote: At the last possible moment, the Wanderer appeared and killed Tamiyo.

events.summary: With Kyodai distracted, oni begin escaping into the mortal realm.
events.quote: oni began escaping into the mortal realm.

events.summary: The Wanderer loses her spark in the Desparkening and the Emperor travels the plane while Light-Paws rules.
events.quote: the Wanderer lost her spark in the Desparkening .

events.summary: Ikoria's behemoths, including Snapdax, invade Kamigawa via an Omenpath.
events.quote: invaded Kamigawa via a massive Omenpath.

relations.note: sent by the New Phyrexian praetors
relations.quote: Tezzeret was sent to Kamigawa by the New Phyrexian praetors to investigate.

relations.quote: Light-Paws continued ruling as regent in her stead.
